=== 1 each start takes the next member ===
> round_robin = ["anthropic/haiku@high", "codex/luna@medium", "opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash"]
> availability = "all"
start 1: anthropic/claude-haiku-5-5@high
start 2: codex/gpt-6-luna@medium
start 3: opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash@high
start 4: anthropic/claude-haiku-5-5@high

=== 2 a repeated member takes more turns ===
> round_robin = ["anthropic/haiku@high", "anthropic/haiku@high", "anthropic/fable@high"]
start 1: anthropic/claude-haiku-5-5@high
start 2: anthropic/claude-haiku-5-5@high
start 3: anthropic/claude-fable-5-1@high
start 4: anthropic/claude-haiku-5-5@high

=== 3 a single model never moves ===
> model = "anthropic/haiku@high"
start 1: anthropic/claude-haiku-5-5@high
start 2: anthropic/claude-haiku-5-5@high
start 3: anthropic/claude-haiku-5-5@high
start 4: anthropic/claude-haiku-5-5@high

=== 4 the turn carries on after a reload adds a member ===
> round_robin = ["anthropic/haiku@high", "anthropic/fable@high"]
start 1: anthropic/claude-haiku-5-5@high
start 2: anthropic/claude-fable-5-1@high
start 3: anthropic/claude-haiku-5-5@high
start 4: anthropic/claude-fable-5-1@high
--- reload ---
> round_robin = ["anthropic/haiku@high", "anthropic/fable@high", "anthropic/opus@low"]
start 1: anthropic/claude-opus-5-5@low
start 2: anthropic/claude-haiku-5-5@high
start 3: anthropic/claude-fable-5-1@high
start 4: anthropic/claude-opus-5-5@low

=== 5 a reload that drops the last member starts afresh ===
> round_robin = ["anthropic/haiku@high", "anthropic/fable@high"]
start 1: anthropic/claude-haiku-5-5@high
start 2: anthropic/claude-fable-5-1@high
start 3: anthropic/claude-haiku-5-5@high
start 4: anthropic/claude-fable-5-1@high
--- reload ---
> round_robin = ["anthropic/opus@low", "anthropic/haiku@high"]
start 1: anthropic/claude-opus-5-5@low
start 2: anthropic/claude-haiku-5-5@high
start 3: anthropic/claude-opus-5-5@low
start 4: anthropic/claude-haiku-5-5@high
